During the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]], a '''battle''' took place on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Siskeen/Legends|Siskeen]], a key holding of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in the [[Hunnoverrs sector/Legends|Hunnoverrs sector]]. As the fighting throughout the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] developed, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] advanced in six major theaters&mdash;the theater where the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]] ends was dubbed [[Siskeen theater|Siskeen]] as it was an important stronghold in that region&mdash;and was able to make a progress in all its campaigns.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|The marshaling of our other forces on the Outer Rim&mdash;at Xagobah, Siskeen, Clak'dor VII, and Sluis Van&mdash;is also near completion. The war will soon be decided.|Count Dooku|<ref name="Trackdown">[[Republic 73|''Republic'' 73]]</ref>}}
During the third year of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] gained momentum against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Intensifying its industrial efforts and giving [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] more power to direct the war effort, the Republic was able to renew its military forces, eject the Separatists from their [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]] and [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] bases and drive its enemy back to the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] and [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EGW" /> In an effort to defeat both the Galactic Republic and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], the Separatists created the [[Morgukai Shadow Army]], a military force built of [[Morgukai]] [[Cloning/Legends|clones]], on the Outer Rim world of [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], the [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] of the Confederacy of Independent Systems, scheduled the deployment of Morgukai [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] against Republic and Jedi personnel with the soon-to-be completed marshaling of the Outer Rim forces on Siskeen, [[Xagobah/Legends|Xagobah]], [[Clak'dor VII/Legends|Clak'dor VII]] and [[Sluis Van/Legends|Sluis Van]], to achieve a crucial victory. Before the clones could be brought off-world, however, the Republic intervened and [[Siege of Saleucami/Legends|besieged]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], resulting in a five-month long battle.<ref name="Trackdown" />

Siskeen, a world of the [[Hunnoverrs sector/Legends|Hunnoverrs sector]]<ref name="Atlas">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> in the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]-controlled part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], was a Separatist holding<ref name="TEA" /> and a renowned key world towards the end of the war.<ref name="EGW" /> The planet was located at the end of the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]], alongside Separatist strongholds like [[Tellanroaeg]], [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]], [[Tythe/Legends|Tythe]], [[Llanic/Legends|Llanic]] and [[Ragmar V]].<ref name="TEA" /> Republic fleets from [[Excarga/Legends|Excarga]] and [[Rothana/Legends|Rothana]], initially tasked to repel enemy units on the Corellian Run,<ref name="EGW" /> chased the Separatists to Siskeen and Tellanroaeg, resulting in a battle.<ref name="TEA" />

==The battle==
While its fleet besieged Siskeen,<ref name="TEA" /> the Republic was able to make a progress in all six campaigns throughout the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], gaining advantage in the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]].<ref name="EGW" /> When the fighting intensified in the Outer Rim, the main thrust against the remaining Separatists forces came in six war theaters, which were dubbed [[Siskeen theater|Siskeen]], [[Mygeeto theater|Mygeeto]], [[Serenno theater|Serenno]], [[Felucia theater|Felucia]], [[Yag'Dhul theater|Yag'Dhul]] and [[Praesitlyn theater|Praesitlyn]] after major Separatists worlds in those regions.<ref name="EGW" />

==Aftermath==
With the start of the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]], the [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|deactivation]] of the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] and the proclamation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Clone Wars ended.<ref name="RotS">{{Film|III}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The battle of Siskeen was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]].
